description: This file implements the Login page component of a web application, managing user authentication through email, organization selection, and password input. It handles fetching user organizations, multi-step form navigation, and login process including navigation upon success or failure.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles fetching user organizations based on email input and manages form state during fetch.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login with selected organization and password, handles success and error flows, and redirects accordingly.
